messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 45):
"""
40) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/59/2/2023 dated 28.02.2023 Modification of the terminology “sub-standard lives” mentioned in IRDAI ( Health Insurance ) Regulations-2016 41) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/054/03/2020 dated 04.03.2020 Guidelines on handling of claims reported under Corona Virus. 42) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/156/06/2020 dated 23-06-2020 Guidelines on introduction of short term health insurance policies providing coverage for COVID-19 disease 43) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/164/06/2020 dated 26-06-2020 Guidelines on COVID Standard benefit based health policy. 44) IRDAI/HLT/MISC/CIR/189/07/2020 dated 14-07-2020 Provision of cashless facility to the policyholders for treatment of covid-19. 45) IRDAI / HLT/ MISC / CIR /190 / 07/ 2020 dated 16-07-2020 Guidelines on settlement of claims on treatment at ‘make-shift or temporary hospitals’ as permitted by Government.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What guidelines were issued by IRDAI on 28 February 2023 regarding terminology in health insurance regulations?","answer":"IRDAI issued guidelines on 28 February 2023 to modify the terminology “sub-standard lives” mentioned in the IRDAI (Health Insurance) Regulations-2016.","facts":["IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/59/2/2023 dated 28.02.2023 Modification of the terminology “sub-standard lives” mentioned in IRDAI ( Health Insurance ) Regulations-2016"]},{"question":"Which IRDAI circular provides guidelines for settlement of claims at make‑shift or temporary hospitals?","answer":"The circular dated 16 July 2020 (IRDAI/HLT/MISC/CIR/190/07/2020) gives guidelines on settlement of claims on treatment at make‑shift or temporary hospitals as permitted by Government.","facts":["IRDAI / HLT/ MISC / CIR /190 / 07/ 2020 dated 16-07-2020 Guidelines on settlement of claims on treatment at ‘make-shift or temporary hospitals’ as permitted by Government"]}]}
